name: redthread
description: Create polished red-thread dual-scene portrait collages from a single photo.

interface.shortDescription: Turn one portrait into a poetic red-thread collage.
interface.longDescription: Redthread creates a finished 3:4 two-panel editorial collage from one user-supplied portrait. It preserves the real subject, reuses one canonical cutout in both scenes, derives a matching paper palette, adds bilingual hand-lettering, and connects corresponding subject anchors with a restrained wine-red pencil line.
defaultPrompt: Use $redthread to turn this portrait into a red-thread dual-scene collage.
Create a poetic bilingual red-thread collage from this photo.
Revise my Redthread collage while preserving the subject and anchor.
